customManagers.description: Test stack image versions in .env (Camunda 8.7) and .env-8.8, each marked with a '# renovate: datasource=… depName=…' comment

packageRules.description: Test stack images: CI pulls them from ghcr.io/bp3, so a new version has to be mirrored there before the integration tests can pass
prBodyNotes: **Before CI can pass**, mirror the new image versions into `ghcr.io/bp3` from this branch: run `DRY_RUN=true tools/sync-images-to-ghcr.sh`, then `tools/sync-images-to-ghcr.sh` (needs `GHCR_PAT`, `GITHUB_USERNAME` and `docker login` to Docker Hub).

packageRules.description: Camunda images move together, as one PR
The Camunda 8.8 stacks' images move together too, in a PR of their own
Moving a test stack to a new Camunda minor version (e.g. 8.9) is a deliberate change, not a routine update
Stay on Elasticsearch 8, which the Camunda 8.7 and 8.8 test stacks support
A new Python minor version in the image's base needs a deliberate look
GitHub Actions updates as one PR
